practices.tdd: A failing test comes before the implementation. The worker shows the test fail, then pass.
practices.format: go vet ./... passes and gofmt -l . prints nothing before a pull request opens.
practices.race: go test -race ./... is the local gate on every issue.
practices.ste: Every comment, pull request body, and code comment follows .claude/rules/ste.md.
practices.spec: docs/specs/spec.md gets a dated Changelog line for every scope decision.

testHost.note: The daemon is live on this host with the namespaces ns-havoc and ns-jbones. Roll back a failed deploy before you debug.
